title: Nano run log v1 (nano replay --report json)
description: Shape of the document `nano replay --report json` writes. Prose, ordering and byte rules live in docs/run-log.md; JSON Schema cannot express key order, array order or byte layout. This is the human/tool audit view of one run. The versioned, digestable artifact is the receipt (docs/receipts.md).

moduleHash.description: NanoModule.content_hash(): content address of the executable IR. Equal to the receipt's identity.moduleHash.

sourceHash.description: sha256 of the .nano source text after UTF-8 decoding and newline normalisation. Equal to the receipt's provenance.sourceHash.

bars.description: Bars in the frame that ran, after any --date filter. A frame with no bars is refused before a report is written.

rowsRead.description: Rows read from the data file before the --date filter.

rowsFiltered.description: Rows dropped by the --date filter. rowsRead == bars + rowsFiltered.

warmupDeclared.description: The module's declared warm-up, in bars.

replayVerified.description: true only when --verify ran the module twice and the two receipts were byte-identical. false means 'not checked', not 'failed': a failed verification writes no report.

intents.description: Proposals that survived the risk gate, in emission order.

escalations.description: Hand-offs to a reasoning layer, in emission order.

log.description: The ordered audit log. Always starts with module.loaded.

warmup_bars_skipped.description: Scheduled top-level rule evaluations skipped because the condition had no value yet; equals the number of condition.unwarmed entries. Summed over rules, so it can exceed bars.

timestamp.description: Integer epoch seconds copied from the injected frame. Never a wall-clock reading. May be negative (pre-1970 bars).

asset.description: Omitted, never null, when the action names no asset.

confidence.description: The literal from source, as written: 1 and 1.0 are different bytes. Omitted, never null, when absent.

escalate.description: Declared agent name (isAgent true) or quoted host target (isAgent false).

event.description: Dotted event name. An OPEN set: consumers must tolerate names not in #/$defs/knownEvent.

detail.description: Human-facing prose. Byte-stable for identical inputs within one Nano version, but not a parse target across versions.

knownEvent.description: Every event the VM (run_module) emits in run log v1. infer.called, infer.invalid and infer.failed need a reasoning provider, which `nano replay` never supplies. Informative: not referenced by the root schema, because a new event is an allowed minor change. tests/test_run_log_schema.py keeps this list equal to the emitters and to docs/run-log.md.
